description: This is a shell script intended for use as a test script for a git-related project. It contains a series of test cases that validate the behavior of git fetch and push operations, focusing on handling of negative refspecs, pruning, and refspec modifications.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Utility to write lines to a file.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files for identical content.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Sets a cleanup command to run after tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
